findings.evidence: Use when the user requests cross-AI review or execute setup
findings.fix: Cross-AI lane setup: detects installed CLIs and models, proposes a review set and an execute set from the model catalog for the owner to pick, asks each role's priority order, effort and opt-in flags, then writes the [lanes] table of ai-kit's config.toml. Writes the per-project ./.aikit/config.toml by default (always announces the exact path), asks before replacing an existing [lanes] table (local or global), and migrates an old review-spec.toml on first use. Use when the user asks to set up, refresh, migrate or check cross-AI review lanes or execute lanes, to sort unknown skills into roles, or when ai-kit-spec-review or ai-kit-spec-execute-superpowers offers it because no lanes exist, even if they say reviewers, coding lanes or config.toml. Supports --check-only (report availability, no writes), --local (force local write without asking), and --global (force the user ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/ai-kit/config.toml directly). Not for running a review or an execute plan, editing [runner] or other tables, or writing secrets.env.
